# Every Programmer Should Know :thinking: A collection of (mostly) technical things every software developer should know. *These are resources I can recommend to every programmer regardless of their skill level or tech stack* Highly opinionated :bomb:. Not backed by science. Comes in no particular order :recycle:
### :star: it and share with a friendly developer!

*P.S. You [don't need to know](https://xkcd.com/1050/) all of that by heart to be a programmer. But knowing the stuff will help you become better! :muscle:* *P.P.S.
